Info

Coordinates viewport camera scaling, centering, and workspace reach fitting.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.canvas.navigation.canvas_view_navigator.CanvasViewNavigator(viewport: ViewportTransform, validator: ITrajectoryValidator, target: ICanvasViewTarget)[source]¶

Bases: object

Coordinates viewport camera scaling, centering, and workspace reach fitting.

It defines:

attributes:

_validator - Kinematic reachability validator.
